title: Idle host holds the state lock up to ~1.2 s (review-result probe, test-run compaction, test-run index rescan and others), stalling mailbox, watcher and federation workers
outcome: Review-result recovery probe and test-run compaction step hold the state lock ~330 ms each, stalling mailbox, watcher and federation workers
acceptance: record_delegation_review_recovery_probe (src/delegation_review_results.rs) no longer holds the main state lock across commit_locked persistence, or a focused test shows that a repeated, unchanged probe takes no lock-held persistence and returns before commit

step_test_run_compaction (src/test_run_compaction.rs) does no per-tick work under the state lock when nothing is pending, and finishes pending compactions without a multi-hundred-millisecond lock hold
Focused tests cover both paths; the existing lock-hold diagnostics show no hold of 100 ms or more from these two call sites in a post-fix runtime observation
